evidence.reason: The fixture initializes a repository and creates commits without disabling or isolating commit signing. At current line 94 it runs `git commit` after configuring only user.name/user.email; if the developer's global `commit.gpgSign` is true and no signing key matches `fixture@example.invalid`, this commit fails in `setUp()` and errors every `DeployTests` case. Setting repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before the first commit is a routine test-hermeticity fix, not a new requirement.
